description: This file contains networking utility functions for reading and writing over sockets, error handling, and TCP socket options such as TCP_CORK. It appears to be part of a network module within a larger project, implementing low-level network operations with error handling and platform-specific features.

methods.name: GQuark li_network_error_quark(void)
methods.description: Returns a GQuark for network-related errors within the application.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_write(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Wrapper around write() that repeats the system call on EINTR to handle interrupted system calls.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_read(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Wrapper around read() that repeats the system call on EINTR to handle interrupted system calls.

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_write(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset write_max,GError ** err)
methods.description: Handles writing data from a chiunk queue to a socket, optionally utilizing TCP_CORK for TCP optimization, and selecting the appropriate backend for actual sending (e.g., sendfile or writev).

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_read(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset read_max,liBuffer ** buffer,GError ** err)
methods.description: Reads data from a socket into buffers, managing buffer lifecycle, error conditions, and respecting read limits. It handles various socket errors and adjusts buffers accordingly.
